visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young men, one in a black 'atdo garage' sweatshirt and glasses, the other in a grey t-shirt with a tattoo on his left forearm, stand in a spacious indoor car showroom with several vehicles including blue and silver sedans visible in the background. The man in black gestures with his hands while speaking excitedly; the setting is brightly lit with indoor studio lighting. (2) The man in the black sweatshirt opens the hood of a white Mazda. He points at various components inside the engine bay while explaining technical details. He wears a luxury watch on his left wrist and gold rings. The background shows 'ATZU DREAM CAR' branding on a large banner on the wall. (3) Scene transitions to the interior of a car where the main character is driving. He holds the steering wheel, which clearly displays a Mazda logo. Outside the window, a sunny urban street with moderate traffic and clear sky is visible. He demonstrates the car's shaking by gripping the wheel and gesturing with his other hand. (4) In a repair shop environment, the main character is talking to a mechanic wearing a black polo shirt and a headlamp. The mechanic looks serious and professional. They stand next to a car that has been lifted by a hydraulic lift, exposing the undercarriage and tires. (5) The camera zooms in on the rotating front tire and the drive shaft. The mechanic points to the spinning drive shaft which is visibly wobbling. The man in black reacts with exaggerated facial expressions, looking surprised and then relieved as the problem is identified.

(2) Vocal intensity increases as the speaker discusses repair costs. A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound effect is used. The BGM continues with a steady rhythm. Mechanical clicking sounds are heard as the car hood is opened. (3) The sound profile shifts to a field recording inside a moving car. Low-frequency engine hum and tire noise are prominent. The speaker's voice remains clear. A rhythmic 'thumping' sound effect is added to simulate the vibration described. (4) A new male voice (the mechanic) enters with a deeper pitch and professional tone. The BGM ducks for technical explanations. Occasional metal clinking and tools being moved can be heard in the background. (5) Loud cartoon-style 'boing' and 'ding' sound effects emphasize the discovery of the wobbling tire. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a car repair journey where the host identifies a vibration issue in a used car. He takes it to a trusted mechanic to diagnose a faulty drive shaft. The video emphasizes the business's commitment to quality control and customer service by ensuring every detail is fixed perfectly before delivery.
